judge.rationale: The candidate only produced the initial TDD setup phase (creating `.lore/dod.md`, `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), completely omitting the actual implementation. None of the production files (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`) were modified, so `ajv` is not installed, schemas are not compiled or validated, and the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and the test file names (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` vs `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) do not match the explicit acceptance criteria.
